doc_friction.issue: The duplicate-PR search found #16157 as an empty claim PR with no files, so its scope overlap (schema gate covering non-decimal amounts) was invisible until it merged mid-run; a claim PR listing intended rule ranges would have avoided writing HU-019 twice.

notes: Step 0: all 8 open entries are control-plane fixes needing their own owner-approved PRs; none touched. Campaign: 12 mutants, 8 caught; gaps at 66 (1e-9 slack: 6702x310x1.01 lands 1.9e-10 past 1%), 520, 547 guarded; 506 equivalent. rerun: 3/3 caught_after_fix. Guard added (4b): ventures/einvoice-preflight/number-lexical.test.mjs runs 0x10/1e3/12,50 through HU/PL/IT/ES/MX readers expecting HU-030/PL-015/IT-021/ES-021/MX-003; it failed on the pre-run hungary-nav.mjs (checked by restoring that copy) and passes on every reader now. Verification: node --test in ventures/einvoice-preflight 1919 pass 0 fail 106 skipped (16 s); eval/hungary-nav-mutations.mjs on NAV's 30 samples (sparse clone of nav-gov-hu/Online-Invoice sample/) byte-identical before and after. XSD facts read from nav-gov-hu/Online-Invoice invoiceData.xsd: all 20 *Amount/*AmountHUF elements are base:MonetaryType, ExchangeRateType minExclusive 0; SCHEMA_VIOLATION is a ValidatorFaultType in validations_en_public.properties. Siblings fa3/fatturapa still emit a follow-on sum warning quoting Number('0x10')=16 next to their schema finding (minor, not fixed). Mid-run, PR #16157 (Hungary XSD gate, HU-027..032) merged and covered the reporting half of both defects; after merging main, HU-019 and the extra HU-012 were removed as duplicates, keeping the sum suppression and the rate<=0 conversion skip. After the merge: einvoice-preflight node --test 1934 pass 0 fail 106 skipped; rerun still 3/3 gaps caught; NAV 30-sample eval identical to main's.

real_defects.issue: num() used Number(): 0x10FE and 1e3 read as numbers, 4352,40 / NaN / 1e400 read as missing; a comma-decimal row VAT gave 'rows add up to 150.00' (a wrong sum blamed on a correct total) and a hex amount passed clean, though NAV's XSD (MonetaryType, xs:decimal) rejects all of them. PR #16157's schema gate (merged mid-run) now reports the amount as HU-030 but still emitted the misleading HU-025 beside it. Fixed here: xs:decimal-only parse; when any decimal leaf is unreadable, HU-020..026 are dropped for that invoice and listed in skipped. The HU-019 rule first written for it was removed after merging main, as a duplicate of HU-030.

exchangeRate 0 or negative (XSD ExchangeRateType minExclusive 0) on a currency outside RATE_LIMITS gave 19 HU-023 conversion warnings. The schema gate from PR #16157 now names the rate; fixed here: conversions are not checked at a rate <= 0, so that one finding is the report.
